founders.name: Sanchit Monga
founders.bio: I'm co-founder and CEO of RunAnywhere. Inference research at the frontier: we make frontier open models faster and cheaper on Wally, so you can run them in your coding agent today. Shubham and I met at RIT in 2019. Before this I built mobile SDKs and platform tooling at Intuit (QuickBooks mobile), on systems used by 50M+ active users. I co-wrote our GLM-5.3-Flash on Trainium2 post with Aman Swar.

founders.name: Shubham Malhotra
founders.bio: I'm co-founder and CTO of RunAnywhere. Inference research at the frontier: we make frontier open models faster and cheaper on Wally. I lead our engine research: trnRT for AWS Trainium, MetalRT for Apple silicon (658 tok/s decode on M4 Max) and QHexRT for Hexagon NPUs. Before this I worked on EC2 Spot at AWS and Azure Arc at Microsoft, and I'm a peer-reviewed researcher. trnRT is open source: https://github.com/RunanywhereAI/trnrt
